claims.quote: We found significant associations between single-nucleotide variants and migraine in 7 genes, SYN1, SYN2, SNAP25, VAMP2, STXBP1, STXBP5, and UNC13A, either conferring an increased risk or protection of migraine.
VAMP2-rs1150's G allele revealed a risk association to migraine, not statistically significant after correction (P = .068).
